issues.symptom: IMAGE 1 is a lounge/living room; IMAGE 2 is a bedroom. Completely different room types. Ceiling fixture similar but wall layout, window placement, and overall architecture incompatible.
IMAGE 1 has couch-centric layout with shelving unit. IMAGE 2 shows centered bed with chair. Spatial arrangement fundamentally different despite same DAKSH branding.
IMAGE 1 has warm-toned ceiling fan light with side window glow. IMAGE 2 has cooler, more directional ceiling light. Direction, temperature, and quality inconsistent.
IMAGE 1 sofa lacks material depth; pillows feel flat. Small side table proportions unclear. Compared to IMAGE 2 bed frame and nightstands which have better dimensional clarity.
IMAGE 1 appears to be generic lounge render applied to this specific room, not thoughtfully adapted. Lacks contextual residential coherence seen in IMAGE 2.
IMAGE 1 reads as unfinished iteration with visible desktop clutter (right side), harsh shadows, less polished overall. IMAGE 2 is magazine-ready.
IMAGE 2 (CollovAI) is significantly more refined, photorealistic, professional, and contextually appropriate for a residential space.
